name: helix-discord-bot
description: Self-hosted Discord bot for RSS/Atom/Reddit/Free Games feed syndication, YouTube/Twitch live alerts, KLIPY GIF entertainment, and guild administration. Built entirely in TypeScript ESM with zero frontend dependencies (native http, node:sqlite, built-in web dashboard, Discord bot, and API). Posts directly to Discord channels via REST — no webhooks required.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:test && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test
